beats.narration_slice: In Kansas City, Disney created the Laugh-O-Grams.
beats.visual: A 1920s Kansas City animation workspace with hand-drawn cartoon pages, ink bottles, drafting desks, and early animation sketches spread across a warm paper-covered table.
beats.purpose: show Disney's early Laugh-O-Grams creation environment in Kansas City
beats.continuity: continues from the opened book by entering the historical animation world

beats.narration_slice: These early cartoons came before the famous mouse.
beats.visual: A stack of early cartoon drawings and flipbook pages from a 1920s studio, with empty character sketches and no recognizable later Disney icons.
beats.purpose: explain that these cartoons predated Mickey Mouse
beats.continuity: same studio desk, closer view of earlier drawings

beats.narration_slice: The Alice Comedies blended live action with animation.
beats.visual: A vintage ink-wash illustration showing a child actor silhouette stepping into a hand-drawn animated landscape, with paper layers suggesting the mix of live action and cartoons.
beats.purpose: show the combination of live action and animation in the Alice Comedies
beats.continuity: moves from cartoon production drawings into the blended storytelling process

beats.visual: A timeline-like trail of loose animation sketches, ink marks, and evolving character drawings flowing across warm paper, symbolizing creative development.
beats.purpose: show how early experiments influenced later animation work
beats.continuity: same paper-and-ink world, expanding from one project to a larger legacy

beats.narration_slice: The story began long before Mickey.
beats.visual: A quiet 1920s studio shelf with early cartoon reels, sketchbooks, and unfinished animation pages illuminated by a warm lamp, emphasizing beginnings before famous characters.
beats.purpose: reinforce that Disney animation history started before Mickey
beats.continuity: returns to a reflective studio view after showing the experiments
